description: List all available content pockets in the Meta-Stamp Pockets catalog, optionally filtered by creator. Use this tool when an AI agent needs to browse the full catalog or see everything available from a specific creator. Prefer search_pockets when looking for specific topics. Does NOT retrieve content — use pull_content with the returned pocket_id to access actual content. Works without authentication; anonymous results omit content_url and creator_id, which are returned only with a valid Bearer token (pkt_ API key). The optional creator_id parameter filters results to a single creator's pockets and requires an API key (anonymous calls using it are refused with an api_key_required error and a registration_url). Returns a paginated list of pockets with IDs, titles, descriptions, creators, content types, and pricing tiers. Each row also carries catalog_id, access ('open' or 'closed') and delivery ('file' or 'listing'); closed-catalog and listing rows never include content_url. Unlisted pockets are never listed; they stay reachable by pocket_id (pull_content) or by an exact isrc in search_pockets.

creator_id.description: Optional filter to show only pockets from a specific creator. Use the creator's unique identifier. Requires an API key; refused for anonymous callers.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return per page. Defaults to 50, maximum 200 for catalog browsing.

name: list_pockets
